## Measured: a map view label blanks the whole Console, not only the route · card thread `session_01WVwANq56oyBZtcDWbWGfva` · 2026-10-26T07:01Z

The triage ruling asked the dev to raise this here first if a map view label blanks the route. **It does, and it takes more than the route.** I'm raising it before any code lands. Measured at `origin/main` `0c372288`.

**Measurement.** I used the harness of `AppHeader.labelLessViewTitle-12805.test.tsx` (real `I18nProvider`, real `useObjectLabel`, an empty translation bundle, display language `zh-CN`). The route was `/apps/showcase_app/recheck_gate/view/NAME`, with two `listViews` entries labelled `{ en, zh-CN }`:

| view | served by the `/meta/object` read? | result |
|---|---|---|
| `served_map` | yes, embedded in the served object document | `render` throws `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})`; body text empty |
| `derived_map` | no, present only in the merged object | same throw; body text empty |

**Why it is the whole Console.** `viewTabLabel` returns `view.label || unlabelled` untouched on the served branch. On the other branch the map is handed to `viewLabel` as the fallback, and the bundle's `resolve` returns that fallback as-is. Either way the object reaches the header's `lastSegmentLabel`. `AppHeader` is mounted by `ConsoleLayout`, outside the only route `ErrorBoundary` in `AppContent`, which wraps the route content alone. No boundary sits above the layout, so React unmounts the root: the header, sidebar and route all disappear.

**The server does not prevent it.** `translateObjectListViews` / `translateView` in `@objectstack/spec` only overlay bundle text, and `lookupViewText` reads string entries only. An inline map with no `_views.KEY.label` catalog entry is served exactly as authored, and `ListViewSchema` types `label` as `I18nLabel`, so the metadata is spec-legal. The PM hypothesis said only non-served entries carry a map. That is refuted: the served branch crashes the same way.

**Same producer, other surfaces (from reading the code; I did not render these).** The object page's tab bar (`ViewTabBar` draws `view.label` as a child) and the mobile view switcher are fed the same `viewTabLabel` result. Inside the route boundary, that gives the route error fallback. The record page's "back to view" state carries the same value.

**Grade implication:** per the ruling, this is p1. I'm continuing with the fix on this card. The fix goes in the producer, `viewTabLabel`, which resolves the map in the viewer's language with `metadataText` before either branch. All five call sites therefore get a string, and the plural-label fallback applies only when no label resolves. `InterfaceListPage` gets the same helper for its heading, drawer title and description.

## Triage: regraded p2 → **p1** (retriage answered) · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-26T07:54Z

⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. `pm:retriage` removed. The card stays `pm:dispatched` on its claim (6410073937).

- The first grade's own condition (6407315350, "if a map view label blanks the route … it is p1") is now measured (6410211342, `origin/main` `0c372288`). A `{ en, zh-CN }` view label throws through the header title, and `AppHeader` sits outside the route `ErrorBoundary`, so the **whole Console blanks**. That holds for served and non-served views alike. A blank console on valid metadata is p1.
- **For the dev:** the fix is resolving the locale map where the title is drawn. Also check whether `AppHeader` should sit inside a boundary, so that one bad label can never blank the shell. If the boundary is a separate change, it is its own small card.
